title: Hong Kong Man Jailed 10 Months for Throwing Seditious Messages
detail: A Hong Kong man was sentenced to 10 months in prison for throwing seditious messages from his apartment window, in the latest case underscoring the continued enforcement of the national security law framework and restrictions on political expression in the city. The prosecution reflects authorities' ongoing use of sedition statutes — revived under colonial-era law and reinforced by the 2020 National Security Law — to prosecute forms of protest that would previously have resulted in minor penalties.

media.caption: Hong Kong court jails man 10 months for throwing seditious messages from apartment
